name: With the Whole World Crumbling, We Pick This Time to Fall in Love
summary:
With the Whole World Crumbling, We Pick This Time to Fall in Love is an interactive VR experience in which you wander through an intimate digital landscape composed of memories, observations and interactions with friends and loved ones. It is set during the Covid-19 lockdown in which we re-learned how to try to maintain relationships at a great distance.
